integrity: Proof by permutation-averaged diagonal SDP feasibility, two-mode spectral minimax and an unrestricted uniqueness certificate; finite checker is supplementary, not a proof. Historical coverage is qualified.
scientific_limitations: Exact spectral condition minimization only for the stated real SPD one-hub equicorrelation family with m>=3, a>0 and strict positivity; excludes general left-right scaling and a=0. Three-dimensional analogue belongs to prior work. Some older block-scaling full texts remain unavailable.
title: Sharp dimension-dependent diagonal scaling of one-hub equicorrelation systems
